body: Greenport Agency, a group company of Narita International Airport (NRT) Corporation, together with Spring Japan, will put on sale from 26 October 2026 the Spring Japan Runway Day Narita Airport Special Bus Tour, as part of the campaign marking 11 November as Runway Day. The tour is designed to let participants experience the work of Spring Japan, its aircraft and the appeal of Narita Airport in a single day, including interaction with airline staff, visits to areas normally closed to the public, and aircraft photography.

The tour offers three special experiences: at the Museum of Aeronautical Sciences, participants can try an emergency evacuation slide and use a Spring Japan cabin mockup to experience cabin crew announcements and service; lunch is served at DINING PORT Goryotsuru, an old-house-style restaurant of the Japan Airlines group, together with a talk by Spring Japan cabin crew about their work; and a special bus tour takes participants into normally restricted areas of Narita Airport, including the Ramp Central Tower, which is found only at Narita Airport in Japan and offers a 360-degree view of the airport area, plus a photography session close to Spring Japan aircraft, including parked aircraft and departing and arriving passenger aircraft.

The tour is scheduled for Saturday, 12 December 2026, from 9:30 to 16:00, with applications opening on 26 October 2026. The price is 21,111 yen including tax for participants of elementary school age and above, with one adult companion required per minor, and capacity is 40 participants with a minimum of 20 required for the tour to operate.
en.summary: Greenport Agency and Spring Japan will sell a special Narita Airport bus tour from 26 October, offering a cabin-crew experience, a visit to restricted airport areas and the Ramp Central Tower, and aircraft photography, ahead of the tour on 12 December.
en.title: Spring Japan and Greenport Agency launch Narita Airport special bus tour for Runway Day

body: 成田國際機場集團旗下的綠港代理公司將與春秋日本合作，自2026年10月26日起發售春秋日本滑走路之日成田機場特別巴士行程，作為11月11日滑走路之日宣傳活動的一環。行程讓參加者用1天時間體驗春秋日本的工作與機體，以及成田機場的魅力，內容包括與航空公司現場員工交流、參觀平常無法進入的區域，以及拍攝機體。

行程安排3項特別體驗：在航空科學博物館，參加者可體驗緊急逃生滑梯，並使用春秋日本的客艙模型，體驗客艙廣播與客艙服務；午餐在日本航空集團的古民家風餐廳御料鶴享用特別午餐，並由春秋日本客艙組員講述空中工作的魅力與日常業務；隨後搭乘成田機場特別巴士，前往平常無法進入的成田機場非公開區域，並參觀全日本只有成田機場才有的停機坪中央塔，從可360度眺望機場區域的景點欣賞全景，還可近距離拍攝春秋日本機體，包括停放中的機材與起降中的客機。
行程預定於2026年12月12日星期六上午9時30分至下午4時舉行，2026年10月26日星期一開始接受報名。小學生以上參加費用為21111日圓含稅，未成年人每1人須有1名成人陪同，招募人數為40名，最少成行人數為20名。
zh.summary: 綠港代理公司與春秋日本自10月26日起發售成田機場特別巴士行程，內容包括客艙組員體驗、非公開區域參觀、停機坪中央塔與機體攝影，行程預定12月12日舉行。
zh.title: 春秋日本與綠港代理推出成田機場（NRT）滑走路之日特別巴士行程
